Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as G3795; rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay:-- wages.
BiblicalUsage: Wages are what a soldier is paid, and Paul stretches the word across the whole gospel. He asks who goes to war at his own charges, and tells the Corinthians he took wages of other churches, while the soldiers were told to be content with their wages, and the wages of sin is death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Romans 6:23 holds the whole gospel in one verse: the wages I earned are death, and the gift God gives is eternal life through Jesus Christ my Lord. I earned death and received life, and that exchange is the whole of my faith.
